text:
Priya K: Quick sync — we're doing a paid push to amplify next week's webinar. Need search + retargeting + a creative refresh. Main goal: high-quality signups, target CPL < $45. Can we lock a pacing plan and lead routing?

Ethan M: Got it. I'll set up dayparting for US/EU. Thinking 8am-8pm local, with +20% bids in evening peak. Any specific audiences for retargeting?

Mae L: Use 7d site visitors and webinar page viewers (30s+) for retargeting. Creative refresh = 3 variants: social proof, product benefit, urgency CTA. I'll drop assets into the shared drive today.

Ravi S: Routing note — HubSpot form -> webhook -> SDR queue "webinar-inbound". I'll add a tag "webinar_march" so we can filter in Salesforce. Need UTMs on all landing links.

Priya K: OK add UTM and make sure we capture creative id. Example for links: 
```
?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=webinar_march&utm_content=creativeA&utm_term=brand
```
Also prefer form to pre-fill company + role to help qualify.

Ethan M: Budget pacing proposal: start with $800/day first 48 hours to get signals, then throttle to $350-400/day. Lifetime cap $6k for the week. Switch to conversions (lead) after ~30 events. Thoughts?

Mae L: Sounds good. For creative A/B, let's route 40% to social proof, 40% benefit, 20% urgency. If CTR < 0.8% after 24h, swap urgency to 40%.

Ravi S: Confirming Zapier flow: webhook -> HubSpot -> assign owner round-robin to SDRs. Also add a Slack alert to #sales-inbound with lead name + utm_campaign. I'll set that up.

Ethan M: Campaigns created in Google Ads. IDs: Search: 987601, Retargeting: 987602. ads-bot posted the dashboard link. Will attach audiences and daypart rules tonight.

ads-bot: Campaigns created: 987601, 987602. Dashboard: https://ads.example.com/campaign/987601 (view-only for marketing).

Priya K: Benchmarks we should call out in the postmortem: impressions, CTR, CPC, CPL, quality leads (attended webinar). Add a note to track webinar attendance rate and SQL conversion within 14 days.

Mae L: I'll prep creative performance tracker spreadsheet with UTM+creative id columns so we can attribute. Will share before EOD.

Ethan M: One more ops ask — please provide negative keyword list from last webinar (I have it but want marketing signoff). I'll attach snippet here.

Priya K: Thx all. @Ravi S once Zap + slack alert live, ping here and I'll give final go for launch. :rocket:
